messages:
jamie: Quick async standup — planning a small capacity drain test tonight 22:00 UTC for eu-west-1 GPU pool. We'll cordon+drain one p3 pool (~10 nodes) for ~30m to validate autoscale + cross-region fallback. Any apps that need reserved headroom? link: https://go/reorg-ticket-4321

arun: Heads-up — what's the fallback model? full model fallback to smaller quantized variant or route to another region? Also do we have quota headroom in us-west-2 if we need to burst?

lisa: I have a canary running that writes intermittent load to that pool. I can shift canary start by 1h to avoid overlap. :thumbsup:

maria: We recently hit a soft quota in eu-west-1 for GPU vCPU on account-42. I filed cloud ticket 9876543 last week but not approved yet. If drain forces cross-region, we might exceed regional quota temporarily. Should we temporarily reduce batch sizes?

jamie: Good call. Plan: 1) prefer model fallback to smaller quantized variant in-region; 2) if degraded, route to us-west-2 for non-sensitive tenants. I'll lower batch_size to 8 for the test window.

jamie: Quick commands for checking pool and cordon during test:
```bash
# list nodes in eu-west-1 p3 pool
kubectl get nodes -l pool=p3-eu-west-1 -o wide
# cordon specific node
kubectl cordon gpu-node-123
# drain with graceful period
kubectl drain gpu-node-123 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=120
```

arun: I'll watch autoscaler alerts and the routing logs. Ping me in thread when you start so I can open the dashboard: https://go/gpu-routing-dash (I can also tail the replica counts).

lisa: Moved canary window in my calendar, noted. If you need me onsite for rollback at 22:30 UTC I can be available.

maria: For quota — if we need to spin extra nodes in us-west-2, we have ~25% headroom on committed reserved pool, but provisioning new ondemand nodes may be limited. I'll escalate the cloud ticket now (ticket: 9876543).

ops-bot: Scheduled: capacity-drain-test created by jamie. ID: cd-2026-04-12-01. ETA: 2026-04-12 22:00 UTC. Watchlist: @arun @lisa.

jamie: Also FYI, small config PR to change fallback weights: https://go/pr/987 — needs a quick review before 20:30 UTC. @arun @maria can you take a look? It's mainly a JSON weight bump from 0.2 -> 0.5 for quantized model for short requests.

arun: Will review in 15m. If it's trivial, we can merge and deploy to staging then roll to prod with the test.

maria: Reviewing now. If merged, I'll add a note in the cloud ticket about potential cross-region usage to help approvals.

jamie: Thanks all. Start time 22:00 UTC. I'll post 'starting' and 'completed' messages here. If anything looks flaky, call escalation channel #eng-oncall. 

lisa: ack

arun: ack

maria: ack
